C1373.title: Hangzhou Counterfeit imToken Wallet Cryptocurrency Theft Case
C1373.summary: Hangzhou cyber police described a case in which criminals built counterfeit virtual currency wallet apps such as fake imToken clients to trick users into importing mnemonic phrases and private keys. The group then used the stolen seed phrases to transfer victims' virtual currency assets, forming an organized chain in which domestic personnel developed and maintained the fake apps while overseas actors carried out theft.
